unique_mechanism: within each target-blind intent version, replace rank 1 only when the current rank-1 product has already been served; use the highest-ranked unseen frozen-C100 tail product and leave ranks 2 through 10 byte-identical
preregistered_hypothesis: v2.10 proves that version-scoped unseen exposure has enough membership capacity to reach HR@10 0.991 with zero hit-to-miss, while its MRR loss comes from moving new products into arbitrary lower ranks; restricting novelty to a previously served rank-1 slot makes every new first hit rank 1 and cannot remove an unserved eligible hit, so HR, reciprocal rank, and first-hit turn should be structurally non-decreasing

frozen_comparator.policy: v1.9 semantic-off nested-OOF ranker plus rescue/RR-regret admission

causal_reset_contract.online_signal: starter.agent.SessionState.version from the current visible conversation state
causal_reset_contract.online_rule: before choosing the current page, clear only this mechanism's served-product set when this is the first response or state.version differs from the mechanism's last_version; after serving, record the actual returned Top10 and the current version
causal_reset_contract.production_semantics: SessionState.version starts at 1 and increments before ranking on a visible category change or parsed override; a new Agent session creates a new SessionState

required_invariants: all 100 candidate rows have the exact same feature bits on each session-turn
each adjacent decoded version is unchanged or increments by exactly 1
the encoded value exactly equals float32(min(decoded_version,10)/10)
every non-final turn has encoded version below 1.0 so feature clipping cannot hide a later reset
goal_age_fraction equals float32(0.1) on every detected reset

causal_reset_contract.state_isolation: the mechanism must own a separate served-product set; starter.small_ranker._history is frozen ranker coverage history and must not be reused, cleared, or otherwise changed

target_blind_policy.input_order: reconstruct the frozen v1.9 full C100 order for the current turn
target_blind_policy.state: one independently owned served-product set plus last_version, scoped by the current visible SessionState.version
target_blind_policy.reset: apply causal_reset_contract before choosing the page; never call the offline proxy eligible-turn helper
target_blind_policy.identity_case: if current rank 1 is not in the served set, return the unchanged current Top10
target_blind_policy.replacement_case: if current rank 1 is already served, scan current C100 positions 11 through 100 and choose the first product that is both unseen in this intent version and absent from the current Top10
target_blind_policy.mutation: replace rank 1 with that single product; preserve ranks 2 through 10 exactly
target_blind_policy.fallback: if no legal replacement exists, return the unchanged current Top10
target_blind_policy.state_update: after serving, add all ten returned products to the active-version served set

structural_safety_proof.eligible_version_boundary: the served set is empty on turn 1 and every runtime-visible SessionState.version change; labels never choose or alter this boundary, and outcome attachment may only audit that evaluator eligibility agrees with it

removed_item_cases.previously_unchanged_rank_2_to_10: candidate and comparator both returned the item at the same earlier turn and rank, so a later rank-1 removal cannot change either first hit
removed_item_cases.previously_inserted_by_novelty: the candidate already returned the item at rank 1 on an earlier eligible turn, so its later removal cannot reduce candidate hit or reciprocal rank
removed_item_cases.previously_unchanged_rank_1: candidate and comparator both already returned the item at rank 1 on an earlier eligible turn

structural_safety_proof.removed_item_exhaustiveness: replacement requires the removed rank-1 product to be in this version's actual-served set, so at least one of the three prior-serving cases applies and any one is sufficient
structural_safety_proof.inserted_item: an inserted target is returned at rank 1, so it cannot create a lower reciprocal-rank first hit
structural_safety_proof.unchanged_items: ranks 2 through 10 keep the same product and rank
expected_dominance: candidate hit is a superset of comparator hit
candidate first-hit turn is no later
candidate first-hit reciprocal rank is no lower
structural_safety_proof.limitation: the proof depends on the visible version boundary matching evaluator eligibility; any mismatch or observed per-session dominance violation is an implementation/protocol invalidation, not a parameter-tuning signal

required_target_free_checks: v1.9 activation and chosen raw hashes reproduce before policy comparison
first and every reset page are byte-identical to the comparator page
each changed page differs only at rank 1
every removed rank-1 product is already served in the active version
every inserted product belongs to the current frozen C100, is outside current Top10, and is unserved in the active version
every output page contains exactly ten unique products
two in-process replays have the same canonical result identity before timing
no individual session, target, product, or membership vector is serialized
required_post_attach_integrity_checks: the last target-free decoded reset turn equals evaluator eligible_from for all 2000 sessions; labels audit but never determine reset
candidate hit is a per-session superset of comparator hit
for every candidate hit, candidate first-hit turn is no later than comparator first-hit turn whenever the comparator hit
when candidate and comparator first-hit turns are equal, candidate first-hit rank is no larger
when candidate first-hit turn is earlier, candidate first-hit rank equals 1
only aggregate counts of integrity violations may be serialized; no per-session vector, identifier, target, rank, or turn may be written

outcome_protocol.precondition: this preregistration and the separate implementation checkpoint must be committed and pushed before the cached outcome replay
outcome_protocol.target_use: after the irreversible receipt only: train_explore aggregate and outer-fold HR/MRR/MTTC/TechnicalScore plus a transient per-session dominance and reset-versus-eligibility audit; no target-derived value may enter policy state, reset, fit, selection, or a serialized per-session record
outcome_protocol.mechanical_failure_before_any_target_met: repair only the preregistered implementation mechanic
outcome_protocol.valid_no_go: record and close this exact rank-1 transform; do not add a threshold or sweep
outcome_protocol.one_shot_receipt: resolve the fixed non-overridable output below this worktree, reject every symlink component, create it with O_EXCL, write and flush+fsync a canonical durable CONSUMED_PENDING marker, and only then permit the first sealed-label open/hash/member access; any existing empty, partial, pending, invalid, or complete file permanently means consumed and forbids rerun; a caught post-receipt failure must overwrite, flush, and fsync canonical INVALID_ONE_SHOT_CONSUMED without deleting or replacing the path

implementation_commit.direct_parent_rule: the exact pushed commit containing this preregistration and no other changed path

promotion_gates.rounding_contract: every metric boundary must pass both the exact-unrounded value and the official value rounded to 6 decimal places; a pass on only one representation is a failure

privacy_and_fallback.fallback: complete frozen v1.9, P11, and R08 paths

decision_queue.promote: freeze a default-off runtime artifact only after every promotion and structural gate passes
decision_queue.no_go: record this exact rank-1 transform and move to a different target-blind proposal/evidence mechanism
decision_queue.invalid: repair only a demonstrable implementation mechanic without inspecting or tuning to per-session outcomes
